messages:
maya: seeing an odd one in the sampleapp streaming test — client reconnects, then the JS SDK emits partial JSON fragments out-of-order. reproducer attached.
rob: can you paste the raw event stream? sounds like chunk reassembly issue, not auth.
maya: here's the snippet i captured:

maya: ```
data: {"id":"tok-1","delta":"Hello \nwo"


data: {"id":"tok-1","delta":"rld","done":true}
```

maya: JS client ends up with "Hello wo" + "rld" but sometimes concatenates as "Hello rldwo" if reconnect happens mid-chunk.
liam: that definitely smells like an ordering bug when the SSE parser resumes and we reapply buffered fragments. which SDK version?
maya: JS 0.8.3, Python sampleapp 0.7.9 — python behaves correctly.
sam: parity gap noted — think JS resume path doesn't use last-event-id correctly when there's a pending partial line.
rob: @sam do we have tests for partial-data-resume? If not, add one. Also try adding last-event-id header explicitly on reconnect.
sam: good call. quick heuristic: buffer until we see a double newline or closing brace, but that's brittle.
liam: another angle: client abort on disconnect can leave an unflushed chunk in the proxy. proxy should trim incomplete line on reconnect or include fragment metadata (seq id).
maya: workaround right now: sampleapp sets SSE chunk size to 1 token and small heartbeat interval, reduces prob. but it's nasty.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: patch/streaming-resume-guard deployed to staging (rev d4f2a).
rob: i'll smoke test staging with the sampleapp and a flaky network script.
maya: thanks. will attach a pcap and a short repro script after lunch.
liam: opened GH issue #2401 for JS SDK resume ordering. assigning to @rob and @sam.
rob: noted. ETA EOD for initial fix, will coordinate with QE for a regression test.
sam: adding unit test that simulates interleaved chunks + last-event-id header.
maya: :thumbsup: appreciate it — this was causing flaky demos in customer trials.
